title: Profile Setup (Onboarding)
last_note: Post-handback fix (caught in my own verification pass, not the implementer's): applyProfileToForm bound profile.photo_url directly to a bare , which 401s for any already-self-hosted photo (REQUIREMENTS.md section 2 -- every gateway route requires a JWT, static photo files included). Added UserProfileService.resolvePhotoUrl(url): routes a self-hosted photo_url (prefixed with environment.apiBase) through HttpClient as a blob fetch (AuthInterceptor attaches the bearer token automatically), while leaving an external photo_url (Google's own CDN) untouched -- routing THAT through HttpClient would let AuthInterceptor attach our bearer token to a cross-origin Google request and risk a CORS preflight rejection Google has no reason to allow. profile-setup.component.ts's applyProfileToForm updated to subscribe to resolvePhotoUrl and reuse the existing objectUrlToRevoke cleanup, only for the blob case. ng build --configuration development re-verified clean after the fix; dist/ deleted.
